scripts.dev: concurrently --names back,front --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev:back" "npm run dev:front"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix back-end && npm test --prefix front-end
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix back-end && npm run lint --prefix front-end
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix back-end && npm run lint:fix --prefix front-end
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix back-end && npm run format --prefix front-end
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix back-end && npm run format:check --prefix front-end
